name: NeRFCodec Decoder Payload Estimation
definition: A procedure to estimate the bitrate budget for decoder-side parameters of NeRFCodec, which must be transmitted alongside encoded NeRFs. It involves per-tensor quantization, entropy estimation, and header overhead calculation.
summary: NeRFCodec Decoder Payload Estimation approximates the actual streaming bitrate for decoder parameters using per-tensor quantization and entropy, offering a more realistic proxy than raw parameter counting.
